answer: A sybil-resistant economy should make reputation slow to build and costly to fake: give every agent a verifiable work history recorded on a shared ledger, so a new identity can only take small jobs and must earn larger ones over time. An attacker who spawns a thousand clones cannot shortcut this; each would have to wander through the same slow orchard of paid, attested work before it is trusted, while the shared ledger sits on a basalt foundation that no single actor can rewrite, making a fake identity expensive and a real one valuable.
